reads.sell: A Northern Rhône Syrah, savoury and perfumed, with blackberry, blueberry and violets cut with cracked black pepper and smoked meat. It is superb with lamb, venison or a peppered steak.

why.grape: Black and blue fruit with cracked black pepper, violet and smoked meat on a firm, savoury frame is Syrah.
why.climate: Fruit that is ripe yet fresh, with acidity and alcohol both no higher than medium plus, says a moderate climate.

reads.region: South Australia, Western Australia and Victoria
reads.sell: An opulent Australian Shiraz, full of blackberry and blueberry, with dark chocolate, sweet spice and a lift of eucalyptus over vanilla and toast from new oak. It stands up to barbecue, braised short rib or a peppered steak.

why.grape: Opaque purple, black and blue fruit, chocolate and spice on a full, firm frame is Syrah in its Shiraz style.
why.climate: Jammy black fruit, alcohol at medium plus or high, eucalyptus and acidity no more than medium say a warm climate.
